desc: Proposed first read-only block boundary after 108. Identify the one right-port removable sd device by USB IDs, capacity and sysfs ancestry; assert no nvme device. Read and hash only fixed GPT/header/partition sectors, run non-mutating filesystem inspection or mount read-only with no journal replay, then unmount and recover. No block write, fsck repair, partition change, or flash. Exact reporter/artifact hashes, independent review, fresh approval, lease, and healthy rig required.
